narrative_text: Jisoo completes homework on her mother's phone because the family shares one device and the internet often cuts out. Her parents encourage her and discuss school, but her teacher has little time to help in a crowded class. She keeps trying after difficult problems but often worries before mathematics tests.

Minho has his own laptop, reliable internet, a quiet study space, and many books. His school has modern computer rooms and technology is integrated into lessons. He feels accepted by close friends, although he sometimes avoids difficult mathematics problems because he doubts his ability.

Sora's school lacks enough textbooks and has no functioning laboratory. At home she has few books and no quiet study space. A teacher explains problems after class and her family consistently encourages her. She believes she can improve and makes a study plan, but she feels isolated at school.
